title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF supported the Government of Nepal to advance evidence-based policymaking covering close to 30 per cent of the national budget by completing Nepal's first Social Security Allowance impact evaluation, benefiting 12.3 per cent of the  population, supported National Statistical Office (NSO) to scale local-level demographic profiles to all 753 local governments, and finalized the innovative Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) 2024-25.
